主要内容: Henry Schein Inc entered into definitive agreements with HS Spinco, Inc. and Direct Vet Marketing, Inc. as part of a Reverse Morris Trust transaction. The Company will contribute its animal health business to Spinco, which will issue shares in exchange. The Company will distribute these shares to its stockholders, and Spinco will change its name to Vets First Corp. HS Merger Sub, Inc. will merge with DVM, with DVM surviving as a subsidiary.
